title: Head and Hand
label: ch:ka-head-and-hand
canDo: I can name the head and the hand in Kannada.

payoff.summary: Complete KA-C13-checkpoint, the chapter's closing checkpoint: say tale and kai and match them with Tamil and Malayalam, find ಚ in ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ and read ೫ as aidu, then write both from sound.
payoff.note: KA-C13-checkpoint (sequence 419, KA-PATH-016 order 1, after KA-S144-digit-five and before chapter 14's first lesson) assesses all three atoms the chapter introduces (3/3). It is the payoff because ಚ (KA-S122-letter-ca, 415) and ೫ (KA-S144-digit-five, 417) are taught after the spoken lesson KA-C13-dehada-bhagagalu (410), which could honestly assess only head and hand (1/3); that lesson stays as the chapter's spoken lesson. Both script lessons sit on earlier path segments, so the checkpoint comes after all three on the sequence and on the path.
